findings.summary: S5.6.7, S5.5.2 and S5.5.4 do not test the junction-first order that their rows require. No test sets a GitScratch.AfterUnlink recorder, and no test compares person.Hash() before and after. The only checks are Directory.Exists(person.Folder) and an empty coai-vh, and GitScratch unlinks a junction safely. So all three tests stay green if OneShotHome went back to the bare deleter, which is the 'before E5.3 g' red that their rows name.
findings.fix: Use the pattern of AKimiConsultationScenarioTests.cs:204-215 in AKimiQuestionRowTests:105, AKimiConsultantCheckTests:124 and AKimiConsultantCheckTests:152. Set GitScratch.AfterUnlink to recorded.Add around the run and reset it to null in finally. Assert recorded.Should().BeEmpty() and person.Hash().Should().Equal(before), which covers bytes and ReadOnly. For S5.5.4, also assert that the check's scratch is gone, not only the home path. Then break the disposal locally and record the red message.

findings.summary: Some scenarios in the table have no test. There is no S5.5.3 ACheckCancelledMidTurn_StillDisposesItsHome. S5.5.2 has no arm where the turn fails with exit 70. Plan deviations 4–5 say this too, and E5.5's 'Done when' needs all four scenarios.
findings.fix: Add S5.5.3: the played shim blocks, the token is cancelled, the record says cancelled, and coai-vh\<8> is gone junction-first with the recorder from R1. Add the exit-70 arm to S5.5.2. A Theory is a good fit, or a second Fact with the table's name.

findings.summary: S5.6.7 must be a Theory with three arms: answered, refused before the launch, and cancelled mid-turn. Only the answered arm is a test, so the refused and cancelled endings never prove that the row's scratch and coai-vh\<8> are gone.
findings.fix: Make it the Theory the table names. Add a refused arm, for example a launch that the control refuses before the shim starts. Add a cancelled arm: the played shim blocks and the token is cancelled. Each arm asserts that the scratch and coai-vh are gone, that the recorder from R1 was never invoked, and that person.Hash() did not change.

findings.summary: Red-first was not kept, and no teeth check was run. The seed rows, vectors, Runtimes entry, planner arm and the flag refusal came before their tests. The epic DoD needs every scenario 'watched red with the message in its table', and no red message is recorded for S5.6.1, S5.6.3–S5.6.6 or S5.5.x.
findings.fix: For each behaviour, remove the line locally and run the test, then record the red message in the deviations. The lines are: the 'kimi' => Kimi arm, 'kimi' in Runtimes and the seed, MustCarryNoFlags, the KimiConsultant HomesFolder disposal path, and the disk row's Snapshot cwd. A test that stays green with its line removed must be made stronger.

findings.summary: S5.6.5 asserts less than its Then. It does not check InheritsEnvironment false, KimiEnvironment.Refusal empty, the none row's --home under RowFolder, no --session on the disk row, or that the prompt (StdIn) names neither root.
findings.fix: Loop over both requests, the same way the Vibe test at lines 352-359 does. Assert InheritsEnvironment false, Passthrough Minimal, KimiEnvironment.Refusal(request, places) empty, --home starting with RowFolder, no --session, and no RootA or RootB in Arguments or StdIn.

findings.fix: Change the text to '§12 M-K9 and §21 M-K9 (e)'. Then run node src_vs_code/scripts/generate-runtime-capabilities.mjs to make the TS again.

findings.summary: Some temp folders that the new tests make do not have the testsToDelete- prefix: 'coai-kimicheck-data-' and 'coai-kimicheck-temp-' (lines 20-21), and 'coai-qkimi-' in AKimiQuestionRowTests.cs:25. The test-leftovers rule and plan §0 require the prefix. The new folders hold one-shot homes and copies.

Some test names differ from the scenario table, so the scenario-to-test lookup fails. S5.5.2 is ...AndThePersonsFolderIsIntact, but the table says ..._JunctionFirst. S5.5.4 is ...AndDisposesIt, but the table says ...AndDisposesItJunctionFirst. S5.6.3 has its clauses in a new order. S5.6.4 is KimiRowsAdmit_BothFlaggedUnconfined, but the table says AdmissionFlagsBothRows. S5.6.7 is ReadsItsCopy, but the table says ReadsItsCopies.
findings.fix: Rename each test to the exact name in the table, after R1 makes the junction-first claims true.

findings.summary: Plan §0 and §0.2 (the plan gate's command) say E5.5 and E5.6 are built on Opus, but this work was built by a Haiku coder. Also, the new deviation list starts again at 1 and sits inside the 'E5.7 as built' section. That breaks the plan's rule of a separate numbering per story list, so the stories do not collide on a number.
findings.fix: Record the change of coder model as a deviation for the operator to decide. Move the block to its own '### E5.5–E5.6 as built' heading and give it a number range that is not used, for example 50–55. Fix the status line to match.
